title: Wonderful Day!
text: Wonderful day!  Authentic family wine tasting and accoutrements!  Sergio was exceptionally kind and knowledgeable!  We would highly recommend this tour!
author: Frank_C

title: Best day trip ever
text: Sergio our tour guide was so energetic and full of information and took us to amazing places.  A full day visiting places we would never have seen
author: Jennie_C

title: The highlight of our vacation
text:
What an unexpected surprise!  This tour was actually the highlight of our 12 day Mediterranean cruise we took in October. We were picked up directly at the cruise terminal in Barcelona. We then drove with Robert, our guide about an hour to Monserrat and learned so much about the area and it's history - all super interesting.  Robert was so knowledgeable about this area and the recommendations for things to do in Monserrat to make our experience the best.

author: Amy_S

title: We had a good time!
text:
We had an excellent time with our tour guide Pablo! He was very friendly and knowledgeable. Montserrat was an interesting place to visit, very different from other places. We took the Saint Juan cablecar to the top of the mountain and walked down. Unfortunately we did not have the correct footwear. Sandals are not recommended. We also saw the black Madonna. On the way back we visited a winery where we tasted some good cava and wines. 

Thanks for a nice trip! 💫
author: bossbb

title: Loved the tour. Our tour guide was...
text: Loved the tour. Our tour guide was great she accommodated all our requests.
author: Meredith F

title: Our guide was a super-great driver...
text: Our guide was a super-great driver and that was necessary on that little curvy road that climbed way up onto that mountain. Montserrat was an outstanding experience as was the museum. We were sorry we did not have more time there because there was so much to do and see. Our trip to the winery was also great. The young lady there did a fantastic job of explaining everything about their making of the wine and the samples she provided to us were excellent.
author: mccoygerald

title: Great tour!  Definitely worth the...
text: Great tour! Definitely worth the value. We had a wonderful tour guide Lydia who was extremely knowledgeable and an excellent tour guide. Loved it. Montserrat was amazing and had plenty of time to tour the area. Wine tasting was fun and definitely wonderful to see....
author: Marcella L

title: Intimate group that lets you wonder
text: This was one of those tours where you felt like you had a front row seat. We were fortunate to have a very eclectic group of people from all over the world. Everyone was courteous.The guide was extremely knowledgeable. But the highlight for me was seeing the Black Virgin  and then riding a train down in the caverns under the Cava vineyards.
author: C T
